title: EXEC SQL without SQLCODE / SQLSTATE check
description: Embedded SQL with no SQLCODE / SQLSTATE inspection after the call and no WHENEVER directive in effect. Unhandled SQL errors are a common source of silent data corruption in COBOL.
suggestedReplacement:
EXEC SQL ... END-EXEC.
    IF SQLCODE NOT = ZERO
        PERFORM HANDLE-SQL-ERROR
    END-IF.

title: VSAM/KSDS file ACCT-FILE → relational table
description: Indexed file ACCT-FILE (DD ACCTFILE) keyed on ACCT-NUMBER. Migrate to a relational table; preserve the primary key, project the COBOL record layout onto columns, and translate access patterns into SQL.
currentCode: SELECT ACCT-FILE ASSIGN TO ACCTFILE ORGANIZATION INDEXED RECORD KEY ACCT-NUMBER
